'''Vernuss''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who favored bright, tacky clothing. He was an associate of [[Thadius Black]] on [[Demophon]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], where he helped smuggle political [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] away from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="I" />
